Q: typed/racket's type checker doesn't let me pass A:

Remember that a proper list, as used by Listof, is defined as being either '(), the empty list, or a chain of one or more pairs whose last cdr is the empty list.

Your function is specified to return either a (proper) list or a string.

(cons
  (string-split* (car s) lsep)
  (string-split* (cdr s) lsep))

does not meet that specification, because it can return a pair whose cdr is a string. If you change the cons to list, it will typecheck.

Barmar suggested using append in a comment, but that will fail to typecheck for basically the same reason: The arguments have to be lists, and your function can return a non-list value. Plus even if that wasn't an issue, it'll return different results than the original version - a flattened out list of strings, instead of a list of lists of strings.

Q: How does bitshifting 0xFF to the end of an Uint32 form a complete hexadecimal code? A:

why not do it all in one clean expression - rather than all this verbosity …..

  color += red; // 00000080
    color <<= 8; // 00008000
    color += green; // 00008000
    color <<= 8; // 00800000
    color += blue; // 008000FF
    color <<= 8; // 8000FF00
    color += 0xFF; // 8000FF000xFF

…… just use multiplications (which is effectively same speed as bit-shifting) :

 color = 256 * (256 * (256 * (red) + green) + blue) + alpha

 color = 256 * (256 * (256 * (red) + green) + blue) + 0xFF

The same expression could be rephrased in terms of bitwise operations only, but one has to reverse the order of the color channels to minimize the visual cluttering :

 color = alpha | (blue | (green | (red) << 8) << 8) << 8

Q: Trouble installing PhpSpreadsheet A:

The main problem is that you manually downloaded the library's composer.json file.

Clear the folder: Delete the composer.json file you uploaded. Your project folder should be empty.

Run the command: Open your terminal in that empty folder and run:

composer require phpoffice/phpspreadsheet

After that it's gonna work.

Q: Replace a value with another from table in query A:

If you don't want to include 'dept' B then use a condition like:

where dept not in ('B')

Also you want to grouped by id and year, then why you show the dept name in your desire output. Because your sum(amt) will come from different department other than dept: B. So, you can't show the dept name there.

I think your query should be:

select id, year, sum(amt)
from company
where dept not in ('B')
group by id, year;

Check db<>fiddle sample code: https://dbfiddle.uk/pWhX4xI2

Q: IIS Express 'The specified port is in use' Visual Studio 2015 A:

It is an old post but just in case someone having the same issue recently; I tried many things including removing websites, running VS in administration mode. Nothing worked. Then I finally changed the port which finally worked. Right Click on project. Go to Web on the left menu. And change the port number at the end of the project url to whatever you want. I changed it to 50645.
